snippet.title: CarX Rally Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
CarX Rally Gameplay Trailer

 CarX Rally is your chance to become a legend of rally racing. True-to-life rally physics, variety of different weather conditions, locations and various surfaces that will influence your car's behavior. Huge car park with detailed tuning system will help you to fully experience rally racing just with your smartphone. 

Download now:

App Store® - https://apps.apple.com/us/app/carx-rally/id1332286428
Google Play™ - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.carxtech.rally&hl=en&gl=US
